People: Ármin Vámbéry (author, Wikidata Q557360), died 1913; Louis Heilprin (other, Wikidata Q6687353), died 1912. Printed edition: The story of Hungary, New York, London, G. P. Putnam, 1886, 1886, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/storyofhungary00vm.
